_comment: Site options. about-nysd.jpg: which synced gallery image to use in the About section - an Instagram post id from gallery/manifest.json (e.g. "17912345678901234") or a filename in gallery/ (e.g. "17912345678901234.jpg"); leave empty for the placeholder. curation: the AI gallery picker - model decides painting vs. not and gallery-ready vs. context shot; newestGuaranteed = how many of your newest gallery-ready paintings always get a spot; halfLifeDays = recency preference (a post's score halves every N days; smaller = fresher gallery); weights = engagement mix; includeVideos = whether video posts may appear (thumbnail only); exclude = post ids to never show; include = post ids to always show (manual picks - fetched even if older than the sync window, never classified, never dropped).
